message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, cult‑favorite, and contemporary horror films that should keep you on the edge of your seat:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Alfred Hitchcock | The masterclass of suspense and the iconic shower scene. |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A chilling psychological descent set in an isolated hotel. |
| 3 | **Halloween** | 1978 | John Carpenter | The original slasher that introduced Michael Myers. |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | William Friedkin | A terrifying tale of demonic possession that still feels fresh. |
| 5 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A modern psychological horror that blends family drama with supernatural dread. |
| 6 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | A smart social thriller that mixes horror with sharp satire. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | A tense survival story where silence is life‑saving. |
| 8 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight horror that turns a pastoral festival into a nightmare. |
| 9 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | A unique premise where a curse is passed through intimate encounters. |
| 10 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | An emotional horror about grief that becomes a literal monster. |
| 11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | A modern retelling of a cursed videotape that haunts viewers. |
| 12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Oren Peli | Low‑budget found‑footage that delivers genuine jump‑scares. |
| 13 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A well‑crafted supernatural thriller based on real‑life investigators. |
| 14 | **Suspiria (2018)** | 2018 | Luca Guadagnino | A visually stunning remake that adds a new layer of dread. |
| 15 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | A slow‑burning period horror that builds tension through atmosphere. |

Feel free to pick any that match your taste—whether you prefer psychological dread, supernatural chills, or classic slasher thrills!
